csv_scope_of_work: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Mobile Directorate of Contracting (DOC) is seeking information regarding capability and availability of potential contractors to construct The Black Warrior and Tombigbee Alabama-Coosa Project Management Office in Tuscaloosa Alabama. The contract will require the selected contractor to provide all plant, labor, equipment and materials necessary to construct the required Project Office, including required site work, utilities, environmental remediations, and ancillary requirements, based on the Offeror s Design-Build to Budget full design, in compliance with applicable Department of Defense, US Federal, and partner nation codes and standards.

title: Design-Build for Black Warrior and Tombigbee Alabama-Coosa Project Management Office
short_description: Design-build project for a new project management office building in Tuscaloosa, Alabama.
project_scope: Construction of the Black Warrior and Tombigbee Alabama-Coosa Project Management Office in Tuscaloosa, including a new office building, site work, utilities, environmental remediation, and ancillary requirements. The selected contractor must provide full design-build services to a budget in compliance with Department of Defense, U.S. federal, and partner nation codes and standards.
services: Design-build services including full design, construction, project management, site work, utilities, environmental remediation, and ancillary works.
relevance_explanation:
- General office building project with no indication of special structural complexity or long-span elements.
- Tender is primarily design-build/construction oriented rather than focused on structural engineering design.
- Building type is administrative/project office, which is generally low priority for sbp.
- Moderate strategic value only because it includes a design component and full building delivery.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated from the tender documents, which state a total construction cost range of $24.0M-$26.0M; midpoint used.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning or engineering fee stated in the tender documents.
references_qualifications: Sources sought notice seeking capable and available contractors for design-build delivery. Specific reference or qualification requirements are not stated in the provided text.
